paras: The Punisher is one of, if not the very best core bit, in the business for coring through very heavily reinforced concrete and the most difficult to core items on the Planet. Shotcrete, Bridge Deck, Lift Stations and Nuclear Power plants are among the most difficult to core items around, and the Punisher simply cores right through them! It is designed with a very special “W” segment which is considered to be extremely hard to duplicate effectively among other manufacturers.
The golf ball type dimples in the segments mean additional water at the cutting surface. This is because the slurry is cleared out faster, ensuring the best performance every time.

It was is designed for long life and is reliable for coring through the thickest of rebar and heavily reinforced concrete. The Punisher is the number one choice of some of the most professional cutting and coring companies.
Available in diameters from 2” to 60” and in lengths from 10” to 48” with the standard length of 19”.
Diameters of 3" and below are available in 15" or 19" barrel length.
Applications: bridge deck, lift stations or shotcrete panels

paras: The Venom is a very versatile bit. It is designed for coring concrete and reinforced concrete and it is reasonably priced. The best feature about this bit in addition to the quality and price, is the ability to add and remove full 12” Barrel length pieces.
It is formulated to core the deepest thanks to its unique feature.

The Venom bit is unique because it can add and remove full 12″ barrel pieces. These are not an extension rods, but full core bit barrel length pieces. When you add a 12” barrel extension to the standard 15” bit, it quickly and easily becomes a 27” core bit (25 1/2″ drilling depth) . A 24” bit is the most commonly requested length (this is because of DOT requirements) outside of standard lengths.
This core bit has the capacity of drilling 25 1/2″ into the ground, thanks to its included 12″ extension. The extension can then be removed to revert to a standard size.

paras: Alpha® introduces the PT Cutter blade which is designed to cut porcelain paver tiles, with the minimal chipping on the edge, using a gas-powered demolition saw. When the hardscaping contractor installs paver tiles for outdoor living areas, the installation technique is the same as other tiles. However, they install paver tiles for the walkways, pool and Jacuzzi areas, where there are many curved lines. The PT Cutter can improve productivity by letting them install the paver tiles to cover the desired area, then mark the cut line, score, cut and release for a fast and efficient project. Typically, tile installers are accustomed to cut each piece to size then install the piece. This is done repeatedly to complete the job and is fine for confined spaces such as inside of a house. Since these applications are outside in the yard, dust, noise and odor from exhaust may not be an issue for contractors, so the gas-powered demolition saw is the choice for most hardscape contractors. Alpha® has sintered a very special turbo rim diamond layer directly to the steel core instead of welding segments piece by piece. This is designed specifically for porcelain dry cutting. Blades made by this method offer less impact to the material, during the cutting application, which minimizes the chipping. The softer steel core allows you to cut the desired curved line, by step-cutting, for a continual cutting application.
